available.feature: Ask a local LLM about POS data
available.limitations: Requires local server and installed Ollama model; results should be verified.

available.feature: Sales, VAT, top products, inventory, profit and zakat estimates
available.limitations: Estimates and reports are not tax filings.

available.feature: Detect inconsistent orders, stock, customer totals and ledger records
available.limitations: Some findings require human investigation; ledger repair needs further regression testing.

available.feature: Generate a single-file code proposal for admin review
available.limitations: Requires separate code-admin setup, a server restart, model availability, and review. Files are size-limited; compiled POS source is unavailable.

available.feature: Propose supported price, stock and settings changes
available.limitations: Derived-data repairs require BOTH a server-verified owner role and an explicit per-message approval. Workers are refused at the tool boundary and every allowed and denied call is written to data/audit.jsonl.

available.feature: Server-enforced owner/worker roles for the agent
available.limitations: Role comes from a PIN checked server-side against the cashier users table, and the policy is enforced in PosTools.call plus every HTTP data endpoint. A PIN is the only factor, the POS still stores PINs in clear text (P-4), and sessions live in server memory so a restart logs everyone out.

planned: Multi-factor / hashed PIN storage in the POS source (P-4)
